title: Tunggu Kamek Kat Tangga
mood: teasing, flirty and quick on its feet
subject: the drummer-singer behind the batik curtain teasing, in pantun, the young man from the next kampung who turns up every gendang night in his cousin's oversized shoes
caption: Sarawak Malay gendang music in the bermukun pantun-exchange style. The seh gendang, a seated female singer behind a batik curtain, plays the gendang hand drums herself, dry slaps and open booming strokes in a quick interlocking dance rhythm that drives every section; a biola violin opens with a short free-time phrase before the drums enter, then answers the voice between pantun lines; no chordal instrument at all, the drums and voices carry the song. Live and roomy like a village hall at night, the hand drums and voices forward, the violin a step behind. A bright, quick-witted female singer trading teasing pantun quatrains with a playful male voice, both conversational with laughter in the delivery, and a small group shouting the written replies. 112 BPM, G minor. Teasing, flirty and quick on its feet. No accordion, no drum kit, no electric bass, no joget or ronggeng lilt, no slow dondang sayang sway, no pop synths, no autotune.
lyrics:
[Intro - short free-time biola phrase, then the gendang enters]

[Verse 1 - Female drummer-singer]
Pergi ke pekan membeli tali,
Tali diikat di pokok nangka;
Kasut abang besar sekali,
Pinjam sepupu dari Mukah?

[Verse 2 - Male dancer answers]
Buah rambai di tepi titi,
Dimakan tupai dua biji;
Kasut longgar abang ikat mati,
Asal dapat dengar adik menyanyi.

[Chorus - Female, group answers]
Menandak, abang, menandak
(Menandak lagi!)
Kalau kasut tercabut, jangan lari balik
Gendang ni tak tunggu sesiapa

[Verse 3 - Female drummer-singer]
Kain batik digantung tinggi,
Tirai dipasang di tengah dewan;
Kasut abang tercampak ke kiri,
Jatuh ke dalam pinggan hidangan.

[Bridge - drums drop out, biola and voice]
Tirai ni nipis, abang, kamek nampak semua
Abang datang bukan sebab nak menandak pun

[Chorus - Female, group answers]
Menandak, abang, menandak
(Menandak lagi!)
Kasut sebelah pun tak apa
Lepas gendang, tunggu kamek kat tangga

[Outro - gendang alone, sudden stop]
Pulangkan kasut sepupu tu esok pagi!

[Song ends abruptly]
